$comment: Index of the ClavaMetrics support center. Defines the WORLDS (order, icons, and per-language title/summary). Pages inside each world are derived automatically by scripts/build-support.mjs from the frontmatter of support-site/content/<lang>/*.md (grouped by `world`, ordered by `order`). Add a page = add a .md; add a world = add an entry here (with i18n for es/pt).
